record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce recent-four-state pooling from 0.2 to 0.1, using 0.9*current_state + 0.1*recent_mean. Stronger pooling at 0.3 regressed; emphasizing the latest causal state may preserve immediate intent while retaining modest smoothing. Mask padding and read the final real position. Keep features, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; update readout metadata and the predictor writer consistently.
